title: Track Web Page Changes to Discord with 10 Lines of Python
hook_text: Stop paying someone to check prices
description: Monitor public vendor pricing or rate pages and post instant alerts to Discord using Python. Includes a production-ready CLI kit with hash caching, custom headers, and dry-run testing.
code:
import pathlib, requests
u = 'https://example.com/rates'
hook = 'https://discord.com/webhook'
page = requests.get(u).text
p = pathlib.Path('cache.txt')
old = p.read_text() if p.exists() else ''
if page != old:
    requests.post(hook, json={'content': u})
    p.write_text(page)
    print('Alert sent: page updated')

beats.voice: Say you pay someone $250 a month to check a vendor page for price updates. That is $3,000 a year for hitting refresh.
Fetch the target page with requests, then load your saved snapshot using pathlib.
If the content changed, ping your Discord webhook immediately and write the new text.
Run this on a cron job, and your team gets notified within seconds.
Dynamic timestamps can cause false alerts on unparsed pages, but that beats manual payroll...

kit_readme:
SETUP
1. Ensure Python 3.8+ is installed.
2. Install required package:
   pip install requests
3. Obtain an incoming webhook URL from your Discord channel (Channel Settings > Integrations > Webhooks).

HOW IT WORKS
tool.py fetches the specified web page using a custom User-Agent, computes a SHA-256 hash of the content, and compares it against a local cache file (.page_hash.txt by default).

If the page is being checked for the first time, it stores the initial hash baseline and sends a setup confirmation. On subsequent runs, if the hash shifts, it dispatches an instant notification to your Discord webhook and updates the stored hash.

Running tool.py:
python tool.py --url "https://example.com/pricing" --webhook-url "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."

Test safely with dry-run mode:
python tool.py --url "https://example.com/pricing" --dry-run

ADAPTING IT
- Schedule tool.py via cron (Linux/macOS) or Windows Task Scheduler to run every 15 or 60 minutes.
- Store the webhook in your environment: export DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL="https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..." so you do not pass it in plain text.
- For pages with dynamic timestamps or ads, strip non-content blocks before hashing by integrating BeautifulSoup or regex filters.

LIMITATIONS
tool.py hashes the entire raw page response. Pages containing constantly changing elements (such as dynamic CSRF tokens, rotating banners, or timestamps) will trigger notifications on every run unless filtered.

SUPPORT
This software is provided as-is without warranty of any kind. Monitor only public pages or internal services you have explicit permission to track.
